confirm.title: Confirm device
confirm.description: The lamp should be blinking now (identify). Give it a name and confirm to add {name} ({address}) to your STEINEL mesh.

import_mesh.title: Import an existing mesh
import_mesh.description: Paste the JSON content of a mesh configuration file produced by steinel_ble.py (for example state/mesh.json). Its NetKey/AppKey and any already-provisioned nodes will be imported; nodes need to be reachable once so their light models can be (re-)confirmed.

error.invalid_address: That does not look like a Bluetooth MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.no_devices_found: No STEINEL devices are currently visible; enter the address manually if you know it.
error.invalid_mesh_json: Could not parse that as a STEINEL mesh configuration: {error}

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one STEINEL mesh hub is needed; add further lamps via the integration's options ("Add device").
abort.already_provisioned_elsewhere: {name} ({address}) already belongs to a different Bluetooth Mesh network (for example the STEINEL Connect app). It must be factory-reset before Home Assistant can provision it, or import that mesh's keys instead.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to {address} to determine its provisioning state. Make sure it is powered and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.no_light_model: {name} was added to the mesh, but no supported light model (Generic OnOff) could be bound - it will not be usable as a light.
abort.mesh_already_configured: A different mesh network is already configured; importing would mix two networks' keys. Remove the existing integration first if you really want to replace it.
abort.no_nodes_imported: No new nodes were found in that file.

configure_firmware.title: Firmware update source
configure_firmware.description: STEINEL's online catalog cannot currently be resolved automatically (see update.py), so point this lamp at a signed .sfu/.zip Nordic DFU package yourself - a direct https:// download URL or a local file path - together with the version/hardware/product id it is for. Leave the URL empty to disable update checks for this lamp.
